global_contract.scope: Undamaged standalone full-target gravity fixture; engineering numerical checks, not experimental validation
global_contract.provenance: Frozen before first ledger run. Absolute impulse budget is about 0.08% of one second of total target weight; angular budget uses a 0.1 m characteristic length. Energy bound is an added numerical injection stop, not physical material accuracy. Original volume, board and settling gates remain unchanged.
global_contract.limitations: No actuator, robot, fracture or moving-support work in this fixture. Fixed support work is zero only after the exact fixed-position check passes. Record numerical dissipation; do not present loss of energy alone as a full work qualification.

local_contract.scope: Undamaged standalone target integration; no robot or fracture work
local_contract.formula: sum over accepted substeps and free nodes of norm(m_i*(v_i_new-v_i_old)-dt*F_i(x_new))
local_contract.force_source: Fresh final-state float64 bulk gradient, objective cohesive force, full contact force, board and gravity; no solver last-color arrays or acceleration-inferred reaction
local_contract.provenance: Additional numerical audit declared after the captured failure exposed cancelling internal errors. Uses the existing 0.0001 Ns absolute support impulse budget as a stricter sum of nonnegative local errors. Does not replace or relax global impulse, angular, energy, volume, board, replay, accuracy or sustained-support gates.
local_contract.limitation: Finite solver convergence criterion for the original implicit-Euler fixture, not experimental material accuracy. Declare history/eligibility treatment separately before fracture.
